SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  irate_right(summary_read) AS read,
  irate_right(summary_write) AS write
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, collected_at) AS bucket,
      counter_agg(collected_at, read_bytes) AS summary_read,
      counter_agg(collected_at, write_bytes) AS summary_write
    FROM
      pganalyze.io_stats
    WHERE
      $__timeFilter(collected_at) 
    GROUP BY
      bucket
  ) t
  ORDER BY time

SELECT
  bucket AS time,
  irate_right(summary_read) AS read,
  irate_right(summary_write) AS write,
  irate_right(summary_fsync) AS fsync
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, collected_at) AS bucket,
      counter_agg(collected_at, read_time) AS summary_read,
      counter_agg(collected_at, write_time) AS summary_write,
      counter_agg(collected_at, fsync_time) AS summary_fsync
    FROM
      pganalyze.io_stats
    WHERE
      $__timeFilter(collected_at) 
    GROUP BY
      bucket
  ) t
  ORDER BY time

WITH per_bucket AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('$agg_interval', collected_at) AS time,
    delta(counter_agg(collected_at, hits)) AS hits_delta,
    delta(counter_agg(collected_at, reads)) AS reads_delta
  FROM
    pganalyze.io_stats
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(collected_at)
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  time,
  100.0 * hits_delta / NULLIF(hits_delta + reads_delta, 0) AS io_hit_percent
FROM
  per_bucket
ORDER BY
  time;

SELECT
  bucket AS time,

      time_bucket('$agg_interval' :: INTERVAL, collected_at) AS bucket,
      counter_agg(collected_at, reads) AS summary_read,
      counter_agg(collected_at, writes) AS summary_write,
      counter_agg(collected_at, hits) AS summary_hits
    FROM
      pganalyze.io_stats

    GROUP BY
      bucket

  ORDER BY time
